verdict.rationale: Typesense's first-party pages claim native LLM integrations for Natural Language Search and built-in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Its docs also cover the retrieval side, including semantic, vector and hybrid search, plus guides on Natural Language Search and Typesense for AI agents. Missing for 10: an evidenced API reference for the conversational/RAG answer endpoint (the RAG claims appear only on comparison marketing pages), and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG answer quality.
